product.name: Velara Outdoor Patio Sofa Set
product.description: The Velara Outdoor Patio Sofa Set delivers a blend of comfort and resilience for garden living. Constructed with a lightweight aluminum alloy frame and UV‑resistant polyester upholstery, the set includes a reclining sofa, a loveseat, and a matching ottoman. Each piece measures roughly 220 cm in length, 90 cm in depth, and 75 cm in height, offering generous seating for up to six guests. The terracotta fabric resists fading, while the fabric’s water‑repellent finish keeps the set dry during rain showers. A simple assembly process with included hardware makes it a practical addition to any patio or balcony.
